# Milty Boulter

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Milty Boulter is taller and longer in frame than [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). However, he is not as wide as [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001)_

## History

Milty Boulter attended school for a year before [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) started, giving him a reputation as a man of the world, and he also accompanied his mother to his cousin [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) Ellen's funeral. During a violent hail storm that struck [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), his family's unsightly old house burned down.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P54](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0054)_
